name: verify
tagline_zh: 改前端界面却不想每次启动 Tauri 应用或加载模型？这个技能直接静态渲染截图，秒看改动效果，省下等待时间。
tagline_en: Preview frontend changes without launching Tauri or a live model—static renders, instant visual check.
desc_en: Verify apps/desktop frontend changes visually without launching the Tauri app or a live model
why_zh: 同类工具多需跑完整环境，它独辟蹊径，用静态渲染绕开启动开销，让视觉验证快一个数量级。
why_en: Unlike tools that need full runtime, it uses static rendering to skip boot overhead—visual checks in a fraction of the time.
